findings: onChange override vs compose: register fields spread {...register(name)} then {...numericHook}, so the hook's onChange replaces RHF's registered onChange. Correct because setValue(..., { shouldValidate, shouldDirty }) drives form state and register's name/ref/onBlur remain applied; noted for maintainers, no action required.
